description:
There's No Dragons is a hidden object game with a selection of 9 locations and random dragons to find for each of them. 

 9 Different Levels 
 3 Difficulty Settings 
 customizable background colors
 replayable with 20 dragons out of 60 selected for each play 
 special hidden dragons 
 hint system 
 zoom
name: There's no Dragons
intro: Dragons are an absolute myth! Nobody has ever seen any!
